# Template accessibility allowlist — files exempt from check:a11y (check-a11y-templates.sh)
#
# One repo-relative path per line, exact match. Every entry MUST carry a comment
# explaining why the violation is intentional (mirror of hex-allowlist.txt).
#
# Categories that justify an entry:
#   1. Intentionally decorative markup where the rule misfires
#   2. Third-party embed markup we don't control
#   3. Pre-existing debt scheduled for cleanup (link the issue)
#
# (empty — the gate starts clean because it only checks changed files)
